## Mumbai Monsoon Week at a Glance
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-rain.svg

Mumbai stays warm and very wet through 2026-08-12 to 2026-08-18, with highs of **28–31°C** and lows of **24–26°C**. For a **20-minute walk commute**, expect frequent wet roads, limited drying time between showers, and high humidity even on the “drier” days.

## Rainy-Season Commute Forecast and Checklist
| Date | Weather | High / Low | Commute impact |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 2026-08-12 | Heavy rain | 29°C / 26°C | Highest flooding risk; plan extra time |
| 2026-08-13 | Thunderstorms | 30°C / 26°C | Lightning risk; avoid exposed walking if possible |
| 2026-08-14 | Rain | 31°C / 25°C | Wet commute, slippery sidewalks |
| 2026-08-15 | Overcast | 28°C / 25°C | Best walking day, but still humid and damp |
| 2026-08-16 | Showers | 29°C / 24°C | Carry rain protection all day |
| 2026-08-17 | Humid | 30°C / 25°C | Feels sticky; rain may still pop up |
| 2026-08-18 | Rain | 31°C / 26°C | Hot, wet, and uncomfortable for walking |

Practical checklist for a 20-minute walk:
- **Carry a compact umbrella every day**, not just on rain days.
- Wear **water-resistant shoes** with good grip; avoid smooth soles.
- Keep a **light rain jacket or poncho** in your bag.
- Use a **waterproof bag cover** or zip pouch for phone, wallet, and ID.
- Pack **spare socks** if you need to look presentable at work.
- Leave **10–15 minutes earlier** on heavy-rain and thunderstorm days.
- Choose routes with **covered walkways, wider pavements, and fewer puddle-prone crossings**.
- If thunderstorms are active, **delay the walk if possible** and wait for the strongest cell to pass.

## Best Day-by-Day Commuter Plan
- **Worst days:** 2026-08-12 and 2026-08-13
  - Expect the slowest commute and the most waterlogging.
  - Use backups like rideshare, metro, or a dropped-off start if available.
- **Moderate-risk days:** 2026-08-14, 2026-08-16, 2026-08-18
  - Walking is workable, but you’ll still arrive wet.
  - Keep a full rain kit ready.
- **Best walking day:** 2026-08-15
  - Overcast and slightly cooler, but still muggy.
  - Good day to walk if you want to avoid peak rain exposure.
